page.overview:
Who is C'thalpa?

C'thalpa is a fictional entity created by Dominique Balczesak for the Call of Cthulhu scenario "Paris, Rêve ou Réalité", featured in the licensed gaming supplement Les Années Folles (1988).

Almost nothing is known of this entity other than that it has some kind of relationship to the entity known as Shterot. Its only mention consists of a single of line in the scenario "Paris, Rêve ou Réalité", which says "SHTEROT, defeated, has returned to the bosom of C'THALPA..."

Category:Characters Originating From Expanded Mythos Works Category:Other Supernatural Beings
